test_stimuli.name: init_and_frame_output
test_stimuli.derivation: Init sequence writes all commands; frame output writes column/page address commands then data bytes. No read-back, so frame_ok sentinel returns 0x00 indicating success.

test_stimuli.name: frame_output_with_data
test_stimuli.derivation: Frame output writes 128x64/8=1024 bytes of data after column/page address commands. frame_ok sentinel returns 0x00.
